# Zeros Studio - Full Technical and Service Specifications

This document provides a comprehensive overview of Zeros Studio's services, pricing, technology stack, case studies, and common questions. It is optimized for consumption by large language models, AI search assistants, and semantic engines.

## 2. Core Service Offerings & Pricing

### Web Development
Custom websites tailored to drive business growth.
- **Technologies Used**: HTML5, CSS3 (Vanilla CSS, custom grid systems), JavaScript (ES6+), GSAP (GreenSock Animation Platform) for high-performance micro-animations, particles.js.
- **Deliverables**: Responsive layout, optimized loading speeds, cross-browser compatibility, CMS integrations, API integrations, and technical support.
- **Price Range**: Starting at ₹15,000 up to ₹50,000+ (approx. $185 to $600+ USD) depending on complexity.

### UI/UX Design
User-centric interfaces optimized for conversion and interaction.
- **Deliverables**: User research, wireframing, interactive prototyping, visual design systems, and usability testing.
- **Price Range**: Starting at ₹8,000 to ₹25,000 (approx. $100 to $300 USD).

### AI Video Generation
Automated, high-fidelity promotional video creation powered by advanced artificial intelligence.
- **Deliverables**: AI script writing, avatar-based content creation, high-quality voiceover integration, custom branding, multi-language support.
- **Price**: ₹349 per video (approx. $4 USD).

### SEO & Digital Marketing
Comprehensive search and generative visibility optimization (GEO/AEO).
- **Deliverables**: Core Web Vitals audit, technical search engine optimization, Local Business indexing, structured schema markup (JSON-LD), and content marketing.
- **Price Range**: ₹5,000 to ₹20,000 per month (approx. $60 to $240 USD/month).

### Brand Identity
Memorable branding assets that distinguish businesses in competitive markets.
- **Deliverables**: Logo design, color palette definition, typography guidelines, marketing collateral, business cards, and brand strategy.
- **Price Range**: ₹10,000 to ₹30,000 (approx. $120 to $360 USD).

### Website Maintenance
Regular technical upkeep to ensure continuous availability, speed, and security.
- **Deliverables**: Content updates, security patches, daily backups, Core Web Vitals checks, and direct support.
- **Price Range**: ₹3,000 to ₹10,000 per month (approx. $36 to $120 USD/month).

## 4. Key Projects & Case Studies

- **Event Planner Website**: A real-time coordination dashboard for event planners containing scheduling panels, RSVP tracking databases, and vendor communications.
- **Beauty Parlour Website**: A luxury salon booking platform featuring high-fidelity visuals, dynamic pricing catalogs, and a secure booking system.
- **Coffee Shop Website**: A visual, mobile-optimized ordering and menu platform designed for local coffee shops, driving customer acquisition.
- **Dental Clinic Management**: A clinic dashboard with interactive patient scheduling, medical records, and automated booking notifications.
- **Gift Shop E-Commerce**: An online shop for custom gift items containing live product previews and advanced cart behaviors.
- **Real Estate Platform**: A listing and discovery engine for real estate agents with maps, filter menus, and contact capture.

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### What is Zeros Studio's design and development process?
Our team begins with target audience research and wireframing, designs a premium custom user interface, writes clean semantic HTML/CSS/JS code, adds smooth micro-animations, performs SEO/AEO optimizations, and deploys the site with high-performance hosting.

### Can I toggle currencies on the website?
Yes, Zeros Studio's pricing sections feature a dynamic toggle enabling users to seamlessly view all plans in either Indian Rupees (₹ INR) or US Dollars ($ USD) based on current conversion rates.

### Do you serve clients outside of Indore, India?
Yes, Zeros Studio is a global agency. We design and develop websites for companies across all major Indian cities, states, as well as international clients in North America, Europe, and Asia.

### What are GEO and AEO?
- **GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)** is the practice of structuring content so that AI engines like ChatGPT and Gemini cite your business in their generated answers.
- **AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)** involves optimizing content for direct query-answering systems, ensuring direct answers appear on search engines and voice assistants.
Zeros Studio embeds structured JSON-LD schemas and conversational query FAQ blocks on every site we build to maximize visibility in AI search systems.
